One nuance: our standard renewal process ties invoicing entity to the contract’s legal party. To avoid having legal draft an amendment, Finance can reissue the invoice with the new payee as a bill-to change only and include a note referencing the original contract number and PO 987654. That typically suffices for ClearShore-style corporate groups. If Legal insists on an amendment, we’ll flag it, but I don’t expect a blocker.

Our playbook suggests we accept Net60 for renewals at this stage, but given the change in entity I need final approval from Treasury to allow Net60 instead of our default Net45 for enterprise deals. If Treasury approves, we’ll reissue as Net60; otherwise we’ll propose Net45 and ask ClearShore to sign off.
